onboarding.card1Body: Your Echo makes its own decisions. You watch, nudge, and converse — but you never control.
onboarding.card2Body: Your Echo will experience joy, loss, connection, and change. Its story is permanent and authentic.
onboarding.card3Body: There are no points, no winning. This is an autonomous life simulation. Treat it with curiosity.
onboarding.bioHint: A bit about you — the observer, not the Echo. Shown on your community profile (optional, max 500 chars)
onboarding.bioCallout: This is about you, not your Echo. Other users see this on your profile in the community. It has no effect on how your Echoes think or behave.

echo.personaPlaceholder: e.g. "A 28-year-old software engineer from Portland who loves hiking and plays jazz piano on weekends. Quietly ambitious but struggles with work-life balance."
echo.personaOptionalPlaceholder: Describe your Echo's personality, interests, and background. If left blank, your Echo will develop its own personality based on the What-If.
echo.personaHint: Describe your Echo — or leave blank and let the simulation surprise you.
echo.whatIfLabel: What path do you want to explore?
echo.whatIfPlaceholder: e.g. "What if I had moved to Tokyo after university?"
echo.whatIfHint: This is permanent — your Echo's entire life unfolds from this moment
echo.inputCareHint: Your words shape your Echo's world — take a moment to check spelling and phrasing. Everything you write here directly influences how your Echo thinks and behaves.
echo.personaInspiredHint: We'll handle this Echo's story with care — life events stay grounded, conflicts stay measured, and nothing cuts too close. Because this one is personal.
echo.personaFictionalHint: Gloves off. Your Echo gets the full creative engine — rivalries, betrayals, wild ambitions, unexpected alliances, and life-changing turning points. This is where the best stories happen.
echo.consentAcknowledge: This Echo is not me — it is an autonomous simulation
echo.consentPrivacy: I understand my data will be processed as described in the Privacy Policy
echo.personalShardDesc: A private world just for your Echo. Quiet, no interactions with others.
echo.limitDesc: Your current plan allows {{max}} Echo. Upgrade to create more, or return to the dashboard.
echo.limitDesc_plural: Your current plan allows {{max}} Echoes. Upgrade to create more, or return to the dashboard.

waitlist.heroTitle: What would your life look like if you'd made different choices?
waitlist.heroSubtitle: Create an AI Echo of yourself. Watch it live an autonomous life in themed worlds. Observe the stories that unfold.
waitlist.diaryPreviewText: The neon lights reflected off the wet pavement as I walked home from the lab. I couldn't shake the feeling that today's discovery would change everything…

waitlist.confirmationDesc: Share your referral link to move up. Each friend who signs up moves you 5 places closer.
waitlist.referralHint: Each successful referral moves you up 5 positions.
waitlist.referralCountLabel: {{count}} friend(s) have joined using your link!
waitlist.shareText: I'm on the waitlist for Multiverse Echoes — an AI life simulation. Join using my referral link!
waitlist.step1Desc: Tell us a 'what if' — the road you didn't take. We'll build an AI version of you that lives that life.
waitlist.step2Desc: Your Echo makes their own decisions, forms relationships, and writes a diary you can read. You observe, you don't control.
waitlist.step3Desc: Export diary entries, share surprising moments, and explore the lives you never lived.
waitlist.expectStep1: Sign up and we'll send you a quick verification email.
waitlist.expectStep2: Click the link to verify, then fill a short profile — your name, a 'what if' prompt, and a couple of quick questions so we can match you to the right experience.
waitlist.expectStep3: Once you're verified, you're on the list. We'll email you when it's your turn. Beta testers get early access in exchange for honest feedback — no NDAs, share freely.
waitlist.socialProofDesc: Multiverse Echoes is built by one person on a single machine. No VC funding, no corporate roadmap. Just a vision of what AI simulation can become.
waitlist.socialProofQuote: "The most interesting stories are the ones you didn't write."
